live_evaluation.note: Live forward record; no historical predictions are reconstructed. Calibration bins are descriptive; markets from the same fixture are correlated. AI150 metrics describe individual legs, not combination returns. Exact kickoff, known league aliases and normalized team identities identify cross-provider duplicates. Earliest publication wins; ties use prediction ID, never outcomes or odds. Conflicting results are excluded. Ambiguous identities remain separate.
